messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Streaming inference tail latency (p99) crossed 1.2s at 11:02 UTC. Auto-detected surge in 'inference-stream' path. Paging #incidents.

sre-oncall: Taking this. Seeing p95 ~350ms, p99 ~1.3-1.6s across chat/generative endpoints. Will run quick triage.

maria: I can see a cluster of slow config fetches from control-plane to configstore around 11:01:45. Some 502/503s. Traces show retries amplifying request fanout.

ajay: DB side: tokenstore and configstore CPU spikes coincident at 11:02. Query latencies to tokenstore p95 up 6x. Not seeing full OOM but connection queue growing.

samir: Auth service is throwing 429s against tokenstore for a subset of keys; rate window looks miscalibrated for recent traffic shape.

maria: attaching small trace sample:```trace_id: abc123
span: controlplane.fetch_config -> 503
span: controlplane.authenticate -> retry -> 429
latency: 1450ms
```

sre-oncall: Good. Immediate mitigations: 1) enable config fetch fallback to local prefix cache (if available) 2) temp increase tokenstore rate window for internal control-plane clients 3) route streaming traffic to dedicated infra pool for high-priority customers. Who can flip the fallback?

maria: I can toggle the config fallback. Doing it now. Will post confirmation.

maria: toggled fallback for stream routes -> ON. Confirmed on console: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/config-toggle (route: /v1/stream).

samir: I pushed a soft rate-window bump for control-plane (internal client id: cp-retries) to reduce 429s. Monitor for tokenstore degradation.

ajay: increasing DB connection pool on tokenstore proxies to handle short bursts. Rolling through proxies now.

support-bot: Notifying impacted customers list: alpha-corp (prod), beta-chat (canary). Support ticket ids created: #INC-2412, #INC-2413.

product-ops: Any visible customer-facing errors? We should prepare a short blurb.

sre-oncall: Error surface: streaming stalls (long pauses, resumed chunked responses) and some requests time out after 30s. No large-scale 5xx to end users yet — degraded latency and partial stalls.

lina: Taking over oncall in 20m. @sre-oncall please capture any runbook steps and handoff note.

sre-oncall: Copy. Running quick dashboard checks and will paste remediation timeline.

maria: After fallback flip p95 dropped to 280ms, p99 trending down to ~700-900ms. Still some tail outliers.

ajay: Tokenstore proxies rolled; 429 rate decreased ~70%. DB CPU trending down.

samir: Control-plane retries still present in traces but significantly reduced fanout.

sre-oncall: Observed one residual spike at 11:12 (trace sample attached). Looks like a hotkey client produced a burst that bypassed client-side throttles. Will add hotkey guard.

maria: Created a temporary feature-flag kill for new rollout (ff:enable-stream-optim). Rolling back for now.

product-ops: Drafting status update: "We experienced elevated streaming latency due to control-plane config fetch and tokenstore rate bottlenecks; mitigations applied (config fallback, rate-window bump, proxy scaling, feature flag rollback). Most customers restored; a couple may have seen stalls — support is handling incidents." Will post after approval.

support-bot: Customer-impact notes: alpha-corp reported 12 partial stalls; beta-chat saw increased p50/p95 but no API timeouts.

lina: I'm on. @sre-oncall handing off. Please paste runbook + any throttles you changed and links.

sre-oncall: Handoff note: toggled config fallback ON (maria), bumped control-plane internal rate-window (samir), scaled tokenstore proxies (ajay), rolled back ff:enable-stream-optim (maria). Dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/streaming-latency. Follow-ups: investigate root hotkey, add better client-side backoff, consider prefix-level KV caching and stronger circuit-breaker for control-plane calls.

maria: I'll open an action item for a configstore circuit-breaker and a nonblocking warm cache for critical routes.

ajay: Action item: investigate tokenstore slow SQL patterns and add index / query optimization if needed.

samir: Action item: refine rate-window algorithm for control-plane vs external clients.

support-bot: Tickets updated and customers notified. Marking incident mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: Good work team. We'll follow up with a short RCA and prioritized action list.

sre-oncall: Closing live triage — moving to postmortem thread. Lina will coordinate follow-ups.

lina: Acknowledged. I'll create the postmortem in #postmortems and assign owners.
